::: {#def-outcome-risk}
#### Risk of a binary outcome

The **risk** of a [binary](data.qmd#def-binary-var) outcome in a group
is the [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) that a member of the group has the outcome
[@wikipedia_relative_risk].

The risk lies in $[0, 1]$, and its [maximum likelihood estimate](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-mle)
is the proportion of the group's observations that have the outcome.
:::
